description: This file implements a ContactsHandler for managing contact data on Android, including searching and adding contacts with permission checks, utilizing the Android Contacts Content Provider.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact's details including identifier, display name, names, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class used for search queries, including optional query string and limit.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Data class for adding a contact, including various name, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checking, searching, and adding contacts.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing ContactsDataSource for Android contacts content provider integration.

classes.name: ContactsHandler
classes.description: Main class handling contact search and add requests, with permission checks and JSON parsing.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read contacts.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to write contacts.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches contacts based on a query and limit, returning a list of ContactRecord.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact with specified details and returns the created ContactRecord.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch
methods.description: Handles the contact search request given JSON parameters, returning a result object.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a contact based on JSON parameters, returning success or error.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input into a ContactsSearchRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input into a ContactsAddRequest object.

methods.name: contactJson
methods.description: Converts a ContactRecord into a JSON object for output.
